reply_text:
You're right. That mission has no HEAD: its HEAD section holds only the template's definition of what a HEAD is. I had noticed the text was boilerplate and still presented it as an example of a reading, which was wrong.

**What happened to it in the machine.** The request script took the section at face value. 象 cited two patterns for the definition, and the construction built six policies from it. In the seven-target run, one of those six was the best-scoring single policy of all 27. The correct outcome for that target is a counted failure and an empty policy set.

**How widespread.** I scanned mission files under `~/code`. M-web-arxana-ui-improvements is the only one whose HEAD section is only the template sentence; 146 have a HEAD with content. I did not check those 146 for other non-HEAD content.

**The post is changed** (regenerated; source in futon2 under `holes/labs/wm-contract/post-what-a-cascade-is/`):

- The three featured examples are now M-distributed-proofreaders, M-essays-diachronic-model and M-self-documenting-stack.
- M-web-arxana-ui-improvements is set apart under "A reading of something that is not a HEAD", with your point and what the machine did with it. It is kept folded so the defect stays visible.
- The defects list now says nothing between the mission file and the policy set checks that the text read is the operator's own statement, and that the Lean definition of a reading does not require it either.

**Dispatched to Codex-4, queued behind the two handoffs already there:**

- The request script refuses a template-only HEAD and does not fall back to the file's opening.
- The registry refuses to publish a reading of one, which retires the existing lab reading for this mission.
- The policy-set builder counts such a target under its own failure key.
- The lab tests and the 33-policy corpus count are updated to drop its six policies.

- Job: `invoke-1790782385603-29184-0d045459`
- Park: `park-9b9c98d0-31cd-4502-9ec8-1343ffa05e21`, three-hour deadline

**A related gap I left alone.** A mission that keeps the template sentence and adds a real HEAD would have the definition read along with it. My scan found none with that shape; I asked Codex-4 to report any and to say whether the sentence should be stripped before reading.
